name: CHIP_INFO
meaning: vendor/die id nibble: 0x70 = RT5133 (regulator_data[0], LDO8 vout_type3), 0x80 = RT5133A (regulator_data[1], LDO8 vout_type4); low nibble ignored
gq5012bf1_access: ATTEMPTED ONCE per boot; transaction fails (no CRC-valid answer) -> probe aborts

name: RST_CTRL
meaning: software reset; write code 0xB1 then udelay(2)

name: BASE_CTRL
meaning: bit1 FOFF_BASE: 1 = base (digital/bias) off; regulator 'rt5133,base' enable_is_inverted
runtime_use: enable/disable of rt5133,base via regulator core

name: GPIO_CTRL
meaning: GPO n (0..2): bits (7-n) and (3-n) set together = drive high; cleared = low

name: BASE_EVT
meaning: base events; bit6 VREF_EVT (also fires when base is off, not logged); others logged 'base event occurred'
runtime_use: IRQ handler bulk-read 3 bytes then write back

name: LDO_SHDN
meaning: bit7 OCSHDN_ALL (OC on any LDO shuts all), bit6 PGBSHDN_ALL (PGB on any LDO shuts all)

name: LDOn_CTRL1 (n=1..8: 0x20 0x24 0x28 0x2C 0x30 0x34 0x38 0x3C)
meaning: bit7 enable; bit5 OCPTSEL; bit4 PGBPTSEL; bits1:0 STBTDSEL soft-start time
init_value_reference_dt: bit5=1, bit4=1, bits1:0=1 (DT oc-ptsel/pgb-ptsel/soft-start-time-sel); bit7 under regulator core

name: LDOn_CTRL2 (0x21 0x25 0x29 0x2D 0x31 0x35 0x39 0x3D)
meaning: bits7:5 VSEL index into vout_typeX table
init_value_reference_dt: apply_uV for every LDO: rewritten only if current index lies outside DT [min,max]; LDO1 forced to index 3 (2.80 V)

name: LDOn_CTRL3 (0x22 0x26 0x2A 0x2E 0x32 0x36 0x3A 0x3E)
init_value_reference_dt: never written: DT 'regulator-active-discharge;' is valueless and GKI 6.1 of_property_read_u32 rejects it (-EOVERFLOW)
runtime_use: set_active_discharge (op present, never invoked by core)

name: LDO8_CTRL4
meaning: defined; only used as regmap max_register

name: CRC-8 I2C framing
meaning: read: SMBus block read of (len+1) bytes; byte len = CRC-8 (poly 0x07, init 0) over [addr<<1|1, reg, data...]. write: SMBus block write [data..., CRC over [addr<<1|0, reg, data...], 0x00 dummy]; max 1 data byte per transfer (max_raw_read/write = 1)
